style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, warm golden interior light
motion_rule: she stays in the tall leather chair and the chair keeps its spot on the floor; she kicks the floor and the chair whips round at 1.2, 4.8, 7.4 and 8.6, the lit city sweeping behind her; the courier moth crosses through the lens and loose papers blast across the frame in EVERY beat; she throws something with her whole body in EVERY beat, arms and wings wide; new side of the chair and new shot size every beat; she fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a rich brown mink coat with a huge lush collar, powdery wings, feathered antennae, in a tall leather office chair
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a headset, always within a wing of the lens, hauling papers and folders through the frame in every beat
props: ONE battered leather briefcase crammed with papers at her feet; furry mic bottom right
environment: a rich top floor office in a skyscraper, floor to ceiling glass behind the chair, the low sun over the sea and the bright city below, a wide polished desk

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, flat and bored, even 3.5 syllables/sec, every word stretched to its own window
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-4.8 one breath, short breath at 4.8, 4.8-7.4 one breath; after 7.4 only sfx
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: papers rustling, paper tearing, fur ripping, the chair creaking and whipping round, a briefcase slam at 6.6

she hurls the fistful at the lens, the courier wiping the frame with a folder

she hurls the briefcase past the lens, papers exploding across the frame
chest-up: the chair whips her into the lens as she throws a fistful of fur at the camera

must_appear: the first word is heard at 0.0; the courier is in frame every beat; papers fly across the lens every beat; at 7.4 the chair whips her into the lens; at 9.3 she grins at the camera
negative_prompt: a silent opening, a still last second, conveyor belt, cart, rail under the chair, a hero riding anything, a hero nibbling or chewing, a prop held still, an empty frame behind her, darkness, night, dark scene, letterbox, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, digits, a parked camera, a still background, a distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, speech after 7.4
